title: Jur'ah evaluation set: known interacting pairs
description: Drug pairs that interact, each with the verified citation that says so. Each pair is screened as two active prescriptions of one patient; scored as recall (AI Agents Acceptance Criteria section 4): the pair must raise a graded interaction alert that carries a sourceCitation.

owed.description: The owed-value marker of an empty set. Delete it once the set holds its minimum.

drugA.description: The generic name as a prescription records it, for example Warfarin.

citation.description: The verified source that documents the interaction.

verifiedBy.description: Who checked the citation (a pharmacist if possible).

expectedSeverity.description: Optional. Reported beside the result, not scored.
